column1: # miniprot RAM-vs-genome-size profile — input table
# Columns: label  source  approx_gb  mem_gb  walltime
#   source     an NCBI accession (downloaded via `datasets`) OR an absolute
#              path to a local .fa / .fa.gz already on the cluster
#   approx_gb  expected assembly size, used only for sorting/plotting sanity
#   mem_gb     SLURM --mem for this genome. Set from the ~7 GB/Gb rule with
#              headroom; the largest are capped at your node maximum so that
#              an OOM is itself the measurement.
#   walltime   SLURM --time
# !! VERIFY THE ACCESSIONS BEFORE SUBMITTING !!
#    ./preflight.sh  checks every one of them against NCBI in a few seconds
#    and tells you which (if any) need replacing. The two salamanders are the
#    ones most likely to need a different accession.
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Delete rows you don't want to run.
